params.body:
## Why

The reader shows a report as pictures of its pages, and a picture carries no link. Since the source list at the back of a report is set by Gentells, every entry leads to its page on gentells.com, but only in the PDF: in the reader nothing could be opened.

## What

- A `links` column on `reports` (migration). The pipeline sends, per link, the page, the address and where it lies on the page as shares of the page (Trendwolves/gentells-pipeline, "A stamped report tells the site its pages and where its links lie").
- `Report::cleanLinks` keeps only what can be laid over a page: an http(s) address, a page number from 1, and a place inside the page.
- The reader lays each link over its page as an anchor that opens in a new tab. Only the links on pages this reader is shown are in the page, so a preview does not give away what the later pages link to.
- The browser leaves full screen when a new tab opens, which used to close the reader. After a link it now stays open on the page it was on.
- A file that is already here still takes a newer page count and links from the feed. Without that, a report fetched before the pipeline sent them would wait for its next change.

## Checked

- `FullReportReaderTest`: a link of the file is in the reader at its place; a link on a page the visitor is not shown stays out.
- `ProjectionReportsTest`: links come along with the file and only those that can be placed (a `javascript:` address, a place outside the page, page 0 and a non-row are dropped); the same file takes a newer page count and links without being fetched again.
- Full suite 671 of 672; the one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which needs a git folder the worktree does not have.
- Not tried in a browser against the live reader. The placement was checked on a sample page rendered at the reader's size with the pipeline's link places drawn over it.

## Note

The reader holds every page in a 2200 by 1248 frame. The links are placed against that frame, which fits the landscape pages every report has today (1440 by 816, the same shape within a fifth of a percent). An upright page would need its links placed against the picture instead.

## After merge

`php artisan migrate` runs with the deploy. The links arrive with the next reconcile after the pipeline change is deployed and the reports are stamped again.
